parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, clothing law, facility ban, or documented police/militia targeting, and no birth-sex custody or ward rule is documented — so not 0.35-tier universal exposure. Severity if outed is still elevated: the Dec 2025 propaganda ban (10-day arrest, fine for LGBTQ information in public/media) is a current state restriction on visibility with unknown enforcement against trans visitors; there is no anti-discrimination recourse, hate-crime reporting has lapsed since 2018, and a 2023 bias incident drew no investigation, while a 2019 privacy compensation shows only partial, dated remedy. Resident LGR/adoption rules are not counted per rubric. Dated 2015-16 marriage opposition is low weight. Thin positive evidence and a new hostile law place this in Elevated Risk, mid-band.
